# Onboarding checklist

> Every new client goes through these steps in the first week.

1. Kickoff call: goals, deadline, decision maker.
2. Send the questionnaire and the offer with one package from [[pricing]].
3. Sign the contract; first invoice per [[invoice-numbering]].
4. Create the shared folder and invite the client.
